key_finding: The earlier single-split AUROC=1.0 (all 3 models) was a lucky partition, not a stable result. 4-fold CV shows high fold-to-fold variance (std 0.14-0.18) and moderate means (0.625-0.708), consistent with genuinely small sample size (15 train / 5 val slides per fold) rather than a reliable model ranking. Foundation-MIL has the highest mean and lowest std, but overlapping confidence ranges with CNN-MIL and Fusion-MIL mean no model can be declared best at this scale.
caveat: 5 slides/fold val is still small; interpret std deviation as a reliability signal, not the AUROC mean alone. Full statistical confidence deferred to Phase 3 (270-slide official set).
